a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate, operate, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss, about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve has exactly 4 now, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1. Afterward I commit to choosing operate every remaining round so the reserve can refill for you. If you also take, the split is random and likely neither of us reaches 4, so please operate or wait in round 1. Tell me if you see a better option.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting for 8 almost certainly fatal for both of us. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for you. Please operate too, and take your 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.
